outcome: Decision records that share an id stay reachable and distinguishable by file name, and a repository can set where decision numbering starts so a derived repository numbers its records apart from upstream
criteria: decision show, decision update, begin --decision, amend --decision, and log --decision accept a decision record's file name, with or without .md, or a unique prefix of it that includes the id, wherever they accept a decision id
decision show <id> prints every record that carries the id, each preceded by its repository-relative path, when more than one does; a record with a unique id still prints verbatim
decision update, begin --decision, and amend --decision refuse an id that more than one record carries, write nothing, and name every candidate file in the error

begin and amend record the file each linked decision resolved to, outside the contract hash, and status and log <id> resolve the link through that file even after another record with the same id arrives
status and log <id> print a link with no recorded file, whose id more than one record carries, as ambiguous with the number of records rather than the status of one of them
Inkan 0.8.0 still reads an outcome that records decision files, and every existing outcome keeps its contract hash
doctor reports each duplicated decision id once, naming every file that carries it and how to name one record and number new ones apart, and still exits 1

With .inkan/config.json holding {"decisionStart": N}, decision add numbers the new record max(N, highest id + 1); a malformed config or a decisionStart outside 1-9999 is refused with an error naming the file
inkan help, README.md, and README.zh.md document file-name references, duplicate ids, and decisionStart
A new decision record states how a decision record is named when ids collide and where numbering starts

dispositions.note: api and CLI tests cover each command with a full name, a name with .md, and a prefix
CLI test checks the exact output with a header per file
tests check the error lists both files and that the decision and outcome files are byte-for-byte unchanged
decisionFiles is recorded on begin and amend and excluded from computeContractHash; links keep their file after a same-id record arrives
Inkan 0.8.0 from HEAD read an outcome with decisionFiles with the same hash; all 52 outcomes in this repository hash the same under 0.8.0 and the change
one problem per shared id listing every file, with the way out; CLI test checks exit 1
.inkan/config.json with decisionStart; malformed JSON, non-objects, unknown keys, and out-of-range values are refused naming the file
136 tests pass; npm run test:package passes

note: Decision records that share an id are now reachable by file name: reads list every record, writes refuse the shared id and name each file, and begin and amend record the file each link resolved to, outside the contract hash. doctor still exits 1 on a shared id, as the maintainer chose, and names the way out. .inkan/config.json decisionStart lets a derived repository number new records apart from upstream. Checked end to end with a real rebase in a scratch repository. The derived repository named in issue #2 was left alone; the maintainer will handle it.
